flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 118, P/B 34.0, DCF overvalued 414%. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Management aims to reach a overall store count of 51 stores, with the majority under the COCO model.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Yes, Vikas here, our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Locations for new showrooms have been finalized in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The Dahod showroom will measure around 3,200 sq. ft. under a COCO model.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.22 pp

opportunities.point: The store footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81% during Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000 in Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "During the quarter, our average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000, supported by wedding-led purchases and festive demand." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 reached INR 853.63 crores, representing a 58% YoY increase.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "During Quarter 1 '27, our total revenue stood at INR853.63 crores as compared to INR541 crores in Quarter 1 FY26, registering a strong growth of 58% year-on-year." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Wedding-related sales accounted for 62% of product category sales in Q1 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "In terms of product category mix, wedding related purchases remained the largest contributor, accounting for 62% of the sales during the quarter." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The company targets adding approximately five to six new stores in the current fiscal year.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: The company aims to increase its overall studded mix to 12% to 15% by March 2028.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "As of now our business is doing like between 6% to 7% of the studded mix. And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Borrowings above equity leave limited room if the cycle turns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.

threats.evidence: DCF intrinsic 409 vs price 2,105 - margin of safety -414%

threats.point: The price demands a very high growth rate to be justified.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 created near-term cost and demand sensitivities.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold..." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: The Adhik Maas period fell completely within the first quarter of FY27.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "We are pleased to commence FY27 with a healthy performance in the first quarter despite the Adhik Maas period falling entirely within the quarter." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: The government raised the import duty on gold and silver from approximately 6% to 15%.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Government raised the import duty on gold (and silver) from ~6% to 15%." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S27/W26/O28/T22), led by 'The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
